title: JBrowse config.json
description: The JBrowse 5.0.0-beta.17 config.json: assemblies, tracks, connections, site-wide configuration and a default session. Generated from the registered types by `pnpm autogen`.

$schema.description: The URL of this schema, so an editor can validate and complete the file.

JexlString.description: A jexl callback evaluated when the slot is read, e.g. `jexl:get(feature, "score") > 10 ? "red" : "blue"`. A slot takes one in place of a fixed value where its config docs list callback args.

JexlExpression.description: A jexl expression the display evaluates per feature, written with its prefix, e.g. `jexl:get(feature, "score") > 10`.

FeatureField.description: A field the display reads off each feature: a name, a dotted path into a structured field (`INFO.SVTYPE`), or a `jexl:` expression over `feature`, which the display evaluates per feature.

PredicateField.description: The field a filter entry tests: a name, a dotted path (`flags.DUP`, `tags.HP`), or a `jexl:` expression over `feature`. An expression needs its prefix.

CssColor.description: A CSS color: a name like "red", "#rgb" / "#rrggbb" / "#rrggbbaa", "rgb()" / "rgba()" / "hsl()" / "hsla()", or a BED triple like "255,0,0"; "" for none. A field name is not a color; color by a field through the display's color channel.

CssColorEntry.description: A CSS color: a name like "red", "#rgb" / "#rrggbb" / "#rrggbbaa", "rgb()" / "rgba()" / "hsl()" / "hsla()", or a BED triple like "255,0,0".

SamTagField.description: A SAM tag on each read, written `tags.` and the two-character tag, e.g. "tags.HP".

FileLocation.description: Where a file is: written in full with a `locationType`, or as a bare `{ "uri" }` / `{ "localPath" }` that JBrowse tags itself.

type.description: linear runs a number along a ramp and threshold bins it at the cuts domain lists; unset, a measurement uses its preset scale and a column one read off its values.

domain.description: a text column's labels that take the palette first, in order, and lead the key, the rest following sorted, strand's values (1, -1) in the order range colors them, or a threshold's cuts; a label left out takes a color no listed label or label met before it paints, the first time the view meets it, and keeps it.

range.description: CSS colors a text column's labels or strand's values take, in domain order, continuing into the default palette past its end; with no domain, each label takes one of them by its name; on a ramp (identity, dnds or a numeric column), its stops, evenly spaced, in place of the field's default stops; under threshold, one per interval.

scheme.description: a named ramp: a linear, log or symlog scale runs along it, and a threshold that writes cuts takes one color per interval from end to end; range's colors, where it lists any, win over it.

reverse.description: turns the ramp round, so its last color paints the bottom of a ramp's domain or a threshold's lowest interval; unset follows the field's preset, else runs as written.

domainMid.description: the value the ramp's middle stop sits at, so a diverging ramp centres somewhere other than the middle of the domain, both sides on one scale: the farther end of the domain reaches its end color and equal distances from the middle take equal colors; unset, the stops are evenly spaced across it.

domainMin.description: the bottom of a ramp's domain; unset follows the loaded values.

domainMax.description: the top of a ramp's domain; unset follows the loaded values.

names.description: key name for each domain value, one each in order, or under threshold for each interval from the lowest; a value past the end of the list shows its own.

title.description: key title; unset keeps the display's own heading, "" draws none.

descending.description: threshold key lists the highest interval first; unset follows the field's preset, else the lowest first.

allOf.errorMessage: is a color, and a bare string is the field. To paint every feature it, write { "value": <the color> }

value.description: the color of every alignment in place of the default scheme.

field.description: field to color each alignment by: strand paints forward and reverse; query and target one color per sequence on that side, reference one per chromosome of the anchor assembly across a stack, track one per overlaid track (pinned under Track colors); identity and dnds paint their preset ramps, mapq its bins and syntenicDepth grey for a one-to-one MCScan .anchors or .blocks link and orange where genes share an ortholog; any other name is a column the tracks declare in attributeColumns, a ramp over the values seen for numbers and one color per label for text (or the color a color column put beside it).

allOf.errorMessage: is a color, and a bare string is the field. To paint every feature it, write { "value": <the color> }

type.description: threshold, or unset to follow the field.

domain.description: labels, or threshold cut points.

domainMin.description: value at the faintest end; unset follows the field.

domainMax.description: value at the most opaque end; unset follows the field.

value.description: every alignment's opacity; unset is the view's default.

field.description: measurement or attributeColumns column; empty is value.

antialias.description: fade a sub-pixel ribbon by the share of the pixel it covers, down to 0.15 of its alpha; ribbon edges stay antialiased either way. Unset fades once sub-pixel ribbons dominate a display.
